assessments.reasoning: Chapter 7 distinguishes definitions modules as shared compile-time specifications and program modules as executable units. It enumerates the object code, symbols and linking data in the program-module binary and the symbol-table-only output of a definitions compilation.

challenge.method: Compare both output descriptions on printed page 101 with the adjacent interface declarations, the earlier 1976 addendum grammar and the independent MPL(B) module categories.
challenge.results: A module category and the compilation product require separate reading. The description of symbol-only compilation does not exclude inline declaration forms in the definitions source. Earlier sources use other category sets and supply no generalization beyond the Version 5.0 report.

limitations: This is the Version 5.0 manual’s compilation model. No compiler was run and no file bytes, portability or behavior in other releases were inferred.
